+// Part: room: Council chamber (parts/room-7.mjs). Interior furnisher and lamplighter for the council chamber, inside its box
+// x5..35 z15..25, y11..15. Spruce floor and ceiling come from the shell. The mayor's dais and lectern sit at the south, facing
+// the room; a horseshoe of council tables (fence posts with slab tops) is open to the dais, with a chair on each side; public
+// benches run down the east and west ends; a red runner crosses the centre aisle. Light: chandeliers on iron chains, a
+// lattice 5 apart, lanterns at y13 (light 13 at the feet, so every floor cell is 8 or more), plus two standing lanterns on the dais.
+// One text layer per storey. Rows run along +x, successive rows along +z.
+const grid = Array.from({ length: LAYERS }, () => Array.from({ length: D }, () => Array(W).fill(".")));
+const put = (y, x, z, ch) => { grid[y - ORIGIN[1]][z - Z0][x - X0] = ch; };
+const fill = (y, xa, xb, za, zb, ch) => {
+  for (let x = xa; x <= xb; x++) for (let z = za; z <= zb; z++) put(y, x, z, ch);
+// Floor level (y11): runner, dais, table legs, chairs, benches.
+fill(11, 19, 21, 15, 22, "C"); // red runner down the centre aisle
+  put(11, x, 16, "n"); // north-side chair, back to the north, faces the table
+  put(11, x, 17, "f"); // table leg under the north bar
+  put(11, x, 18, "u"); // south-side chair, back to the south, faces the table
+  put(11, 16, z, "f"); // west arm table leg
+  put(11, 24, z, "f"); // east arm table leg
+  put(11, 7, z, "w"); // public bench, west end, back to the wall
+  put(11, 33, z, "e"); // public bench, east end
+// Table tops (y12): the north bar and the two arms, the mayor's lectern and chair, two standing lanterns on the dais.
+put(12, 20, 24, "m"); // mayor's chair, back to the south wall
+// Chandeliers: a lattice 5 apart over the chamber, with one extra at the south-east corner. Lantern at y13 under two
+// chains (y14, y15) from the ceiling at y16.

Council chamber furnished in parts/room-7.mjs: mayor's dais and lectern at the south, a horseshoe of council tables with chairs, public benches at the east and west ends, a red runner, and 13 chandeliers on iron chains (lanterns at y13).
`$MCD room` says OK: 308 of 308 floor cells reachable, minimum light 8, no dark cells. make.sh saved a whole build.nbt with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines for my part.

waste.what: Worked out the stair-chair facing for every seat by hand (chair north of a table faces north, and so on), and the chandelier lattice spacing by hand (lantern light 13 at y13, so the 5-apart L1 ≤ 5 rule).
waste.cost: about 10 minutes of mental coordinate work and one wrong guess at the chandelier count before the room check
waste.tool: A furnishing helper in vocab (e.g. tableRow(g, {x0,x1,z,y,face}) that places the fence legs, slab top and facing chairs in one call) and a lattice-lighting helper that places chandeliers on a given spacing and reports the L1 coverage, so the lamplighter's check is a single call instead of hand arithmetic.

waste.what: Typed the floor layout as five hand-filled character grids inside the part module, cell by cell with fill() and put() loops.
waste.cost: about 40 lines of coordinate code and a re-run of make.sh to confirm the layout
waste.tool: `$MCD plan` could print an editable grid with a 'free' mask per storey, so the furniture grid starts from a copy of it instead of being reconstructed from the room box.

companions.task: Set the chairs and the benches: the facing of each dark_oak_stairs seat, so the backs face the walls and the seats face the tables and the dais.
Confirm the chandelier spacing and the standing lanterns on the dais, so the focal piece is brightest, before the room check.
Build the council table tops and the mayor's dais as a single run, with fence-post legs, so the horseshoe reads as one piece of furniture.

left: The furniture set is thin: no flower pots, barrels, bookshelves or item-level clutter on the walls or benches, so the room reads as a council chamber without much detail.
The dais lectern is hard to see from above in room.png; a lectern on the dais top may need a second read from the rooms view.
plan.md's Checklist and elements.md item 23 are not ticked: that item covers the whole interior, and only the council chamber is done here.
